query: SELECT m.id FROM loyalty_customers m JOIN customers c ON c.id = m.id WHERE c.erased_at IS NOT NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND (m.apple_auth_token IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loyalty_pass_devices d WHERE d.customer_id = m.id)) AND c.erased_at < now() - make_interval(hours => $1) LIMIT 500
